instructions:
1. Sit on a bench with your back straight and feet flat on the floor, holding a dumbbell in each hand at your sides, palms facing your thighs.
2. Raise your right arm straight in front of you to shoulder height, keeping a slight bend in the elbow.
3. Lower your right arm back to the start with control.
4. Raise your left arm to shoulder height in the same way.
5. Lower your left arm back to the start.
6. Repeat.
tips:
1. Exhale as you raise, inhale as you lower.
2. Do not swing your torso or use momentum.
3. Keep the wrist neutral and the dumbbell level.
4. Stop at shoulder height; no need to go higher.

instructions:
1. Sit on a bench with back support, feet flat on the floor, holding a dumbbell in each hand at shoulder height, palms facing forward.
2. Press the right dumbbell overhead until the arm is fully extended.
3. Lower the right dumbbell back to shoulder height with control.
4. Press the left dumbbell overhead until the arm is fully extended.
5. Lower the left dumbbell back to shoulder height.
6. Repeat.
tips:
1. Keep your wrists straight and stacked over your forearms.
2. Brace your core to keep your torso stable.
3. Press in a controlled line without jerking.
4. Do not shrug the shoulders up toward the ears.

instructions:
1. Sit on a bench with back support, feet flat on the floor, holding a dumbbell in each hand at shoulder level, palms facing forward, elbows out.
2. Press the right dumbbell overhead until the arm is fully extended.
3. Lower the right dumbbell back to shoulder level as you start pressing the left dumbbell up.
4. Press the left dumbbell overhead until the arm is fully extended.
5. Lower the left dumbbell back to shoulder level.
6. Repeat.
tips:
1. Press in a controlled manner without jerking.
2. Keep the shoulders down; do not shrug during the press.
3. Brace the core to keep the torso upright.
4. Keep wrists stacked over the forearms.

instructions:
1. Sit on a bench with your back straight and feet flat on the floor, holding one dumbbell with both hands behind your head.
2. Start with elbows bent and pointed up, upper arms close to your head.
3. Extend your elbows to raise the dumbbell overhead until the arms are fully straight.
4. Lower the dumbbell back behind your head with control.
5. Repeat.
tips:
1. Keep your elbows close to your head; do not flare them out.
2. Exhale as you extend, inhale as you lower.
3. Keep the upper arms still and move only at the elbows.
4. Control the lowering phase for a full stretch.

instructions:
1. Sit on a bench with the balls of your feet on a weight plate and heels on the floor, feet hip-width apart.
2. Rest a dumbbell on each knee, holding them in place with your hands.
3. Push through the balls of your feet to lift your heels as high as possible.
4. Pause and squeeze your calves at the top.
5. Lower your heels back down with control for a full stretch.
6. Repeat.
tips:
1. Keep the dumbbells balanced on your knees throughout.
2. Use a full range of motion, deep stretch at the bottom and full squeeze at the top.
3. Move slowly; do not bounce or use momentum.
4. Keep the balls of your feet firmly on the plate.
